meta.title: perf: Implement worker threads for getAvailableSlots to prevent CPU blocking
meta.body_summary: Offload CPU-intensive getAvailableSlots to Node.js worker threads to prevent main thread blocking and reduce 502 errors on /v2/slots/available endpoint.

perf_labels.notes: Devin implemented worker pool; maintainer ThyMinimalDev added several fixes (error handling, E2E, memory leak) and approved after iterative review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7159 changed lines across 197 files, this is a large edit by absolute volume, but most churn comes from main merges. The performance-related changes are about 200–300 lines in a few new files. The PR merged after multiple rounds of human fixes and approval, which is consistent with medium-size cross-cutting concerns.

review_details.concern_detail: ThyMinimalDev raised multiple inline comments: questioning the use of TRPCError in the worker service, noting poor error handling in the worker file, and indicating that error propagation should not create TRPCError but handle properly. Also flagged a memory leak (later fixed).
review_details.performance_claim: Offload CPU-intensive getAvailableSlots to worker threads to prevent main thread blocking and reduce 502 errors.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Node.js worker_threads with NestJS integration required careful error handling, TRPCError usage correctness, E2E test compatibility, and memory leak avoidance; Devin provided an initial framework but needed significant human follow-up to reach production quality.

detection_detail.code_reading: ThyMinimalDev reviewed the new worker service and worker file line-by-line, flagging TRPCError misuse and insufficient error handling.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data provided to validate the performance claim; review focused on code quality not perf measurement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After initial comments, ThyMinimalDev committed fixes for worker service, E2E compatibility (do not use workers in E2E), and attempted a memory leak fix; later approved after additional merges.

core_change_summary.description: Added slots.worker.ts and slots-worker.service.ts to run getAvailableSlots in Node.js worker threads with a pool of workers; updated the slots controller to use the worker service.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most of the 7159 changed lines come from a merge of main branch, bringing extensive unrelated changes (locale files, calendar service tests, etc.).
